body.en: Add papers can now browse your Zotero library, including its collections and sub-collections, and bring in the papers you pick.
body.zh: “添加论文”现在可以浏览你的 Zotero 文献库，包括其中的分类和子分类，并导入你选中的论文。

body.en: Your co-authors' edits survive conflict saves, remote deletes and restores. Typing at the same time as a co-author stays in live editing instead of falling back to a full sync, and Lattice sends its sync edits to Overleaf as live edits too. Syncing fetches only the files that changed instead of the whole project, and a co-author's live typing no longer rebuilds the PDF on every keystroke.
body.zh: 保存冲突、远端删除和恢复文件时，合作者的修改都会保留。和合作者同时输入时会继续保持实时编辑，不再退回完整同步；Lattice 同步的修改也会以实时编辑的方式发送到 Overleaf。同步时只获取有改动的文件，不再下载整个项目；合作者实时输入时，也不会每敲一个键就重新编译一次 PDF。

title.zh: 在 PDF 旁查看评论

body.en: Read and answer comments in a column next to the PDF, and comment on a PDF passage from any source file in one step.
body.zh: 在 PDF 旁边的一栏里阅读和回复评论；无论打开的是哪个源文件，都能一步给 PDF 中的段落添加评论。

body.en: A review mode in History shows changes as tracked edits you can accept or reject, with the changes marked in the PDF.
body.zh: 历史记录新增审阅模式：改动以修订的形式显示，可以逐条接受或拒绝，PDF 中也会标出这些改动。

body.en: Notes link to the exact page of the cited paper, and you can add an optional "why I cited this" reason to each citation.
body.zh: 笔记会链接到被引论文的具体页码；每处引用还可以选择写下“为什么引用它”的理由。

title.en: More ways to set up and write

body.en: Choose the font, size and line height of the source and Markdown editors in Settings, clone a Git repository into a new project, and use Vim's :w, :q and :wq. There is also a new CVPR 2027 Rebuttal template.
body.zh: 可以在设置中选择源码编辑器和 Markdown 编辑器的字体、字号与行高；可以把 Git 仓库克隆为新项目；Vim 的 :w、:q 和 :wq 也能用了。另外新增了 CVPR 2027 Rebuttal 模板。

body.en: Each release now includes a signed, notarized Intel (x64) Mac build.
body.zh: 每个版本现在都附带经过签名和公证的 Intel（x64）Mac 版本。

fixes.en: Undoing an AI assistant edit keeps your co-authors' edits, and turns overlapping changes into conflicts instead of overwriting them.
fixes.zh: 撤销 AI 助手的修改时会保留合作者的修改；有重叠的改动会标记为冲突，而不会被覆盖。

fixes.en: Annotations and bibliography edits are never saved over stale or unread text, and an audit of hidden state bugs fixed more cases like it.
fixes.zh: 批注和参考文献的修改不会再覆盖过时或尚未读取的内容；一次针对隐藏状态问题的排查还修复了更多类似情况。

fixes.en: Overleaf reconnect, switching projects, stopping a build, Fix all and reloading the AI assistant panel no longer get stuck.
fixes.zh: Overleaf 重新连接、切换项目、停止编译、“一键修复”以及重新加载 AI 助手面板时不会再卡住。

fixes.en: Format document results and Overleaf's rejected edits stay tied to the right text.
fixes.zh: “整理排版”的结果和被 Overleaf 拒绝的修改会对应到正确的文本。

fixes.en: Files that still have conflict markers are not merged again, and fallback uploads to Overleaf are checked against their own history.
fixes.zh: 仍带有冲突标记的文件不会再被重复合并；向 Overleaf 的备用上传会对照它自己的历史进行校验。

fixes.en: Bibliography upgrades apply entry by entry instead of tidying the whole file.
fixes.zh: 参考文献升级会逐条应用，不再整理整个文件。

fixes.en: A citation card under a comment stays reachable.
fixes.zh: 被评论遮住的引用卡片现在也能点到。

fixes.en: Citation suggestions stay open while you backspace through keys. Thanks to @ajay-mk.
fixes.zh: 用退格键删除引用键时，引用建议会保持显示。感谢 @ajay-mk。

fixes.en: The AI assistant explains when your Codex is too old to list GPT-6 Astra.
fixes.zh: Codex 版本太旧、无法列出 GPT-6 Astra 时，AI 助手会说明原因。

fixes.en: Linux users are told when a new release is out. Thanks to @knightnemo.
fixes.zh: 有新版本发布时会通知 Linux 用户。感谢 @knightnemo。

fixes.en: The empty annotations panel is redrawn without "Return to file", the Git drawer's empty states are centred, and the in-app Lattice mark uses the icon's olive and sage.
fixes.zh: 空的批注面板重新设计，去掉了“返回文件”；Git 抽屉的空状态改为居中显示；应用内的 Lattice 标志改用图标的橄榄绿和鼠尾草绿。

fixes.en: Developers: steadier perf-bench startup and Linux AppImage end-to-end tests.
fixes.zh: 开发者：perf-bench 启动和 Linux AppImage 端到端测试更稳定。
